g.text: Where the official Embark discount actually comes from
Read from embarkvet.com product and Deals pages plus Embark's help center on 2026-09-26. No standing public promo code is published today.
Price cut already on the page (no code needed)
Breed + Health test
13% off
Breed + Health + Age bundle
11% off
Breed ID test
8% off
Breed ID + Age bundle
6% off
Purebred test
13% off
Deals page also lists: Subscribe & save 50% off your first
supplements order, and the two test bundles above.
embarkvet.com product pages and /pages/sale, read 2026-09-26.
The other official channels
Refer A Friend: $10 + $10
Friend gets $10 off a first Breed + Health or Purebred
kit priced $139+; you get a $10 coupon, expires in 90 days.
Veterinary professionals: one-time $10
Breed + Health or Purebred kit, proof of role required.
Email list is where codes are sent
Offers may include special discount codes or sale updates.
No first-time-buyer sale running
Embark's help center: no specific first-time purchaser
sale; codes from external coupon sites may not be honored.
Stacking rule: referral discounts cannot be combined with other offers; the veterinary discount cannot be combined either.
Embark also prints that a promo code cannot be used to buy a gift card.
Sources: embarkvet.com Deals page, product and bundle pages, eGift card page, and help.embarkvet.com articles on first-time purchasers,
email promotions, failed discount codes, Refer A Friend, veterinary discounts and multi-test discounts. Read 2026-09-26.
Prices and offers change; re-read the official page before buying.
